items.Sentence: The treatment system at the Facility consists of preliminary influent bar screening with a Parshall flume and ultrasonic level sensor
The treatment system at the Facility consists of... an aeration basin divided into two equally sized cells
Two 2.5-acre evaporation and percolation ponds are provided to receive effluent from the aeration basin. The ponds serve as settling basins for solids from the aeration process
The treatment system at the Facility consists of... a horizontal pressure filter
...and chlorine disinfection (with liquid sodium hypochlorite) and dechlorination (with liquid sodium bisulfite).
